items.ref: Re tshwanetse go aga setshwantsho sa bokamoso se se ntšha go lefelo le le  mo nageng ya rona jaaka re bitsa  mmasepala ono ka ena.

items.hyp: Kgwetlho, botlhokatiro, thulaganyo le semmuso se tlaa dira se re se tlhagisa mme jaaka re tlaa tshwanetse go tswa kwa Mbizana Local Municipality, re tlaa dira gore re tlile go dira ka bonako go tswa mo go ba ba tshelang ka ditiro tse ba tse di tshwanang mo go rona, mo go tse di dira.
items.ref: Tlala, lehuma, botlhokatiro le go tlhoka tekatekano ke dingwe tse re tshwanetseng go lwana le tsona ka dikakanyo tsotlhe tsa rona mme jaaka re tlogela leina la Mmasepala wa selegae la Mbizana, re tshwanetse gape go netefatsa gore re dira ka natla go tlogela dilo tsotlhe tse di neng di le morwalo mo go bathong ba rona.

items.hyp: Tonakgolo ya Dipatlisiso tsa Bosenyi le Tlhamamo (COGTA), Nnamo le ena le tshwanetse go tlhomiwa ga Mbizana go tswa mo mmasepameng wa Winnie Madikizela Mandela Local Municipality.
items.ref: Tona ya Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), Ngk Nkosazana Dlamini Zuma o ne a tsenetse moletlo o wa semmuso wa go fetola leina la Mbizana go nna Mmasepala wa selegae wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

items.hyp: Mmeyara wa mmasepala wa kwa mokgatlhong wa Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa Mafumbatha, a re go na le dipotso tse di tshwanang go bona gore batho ba le babedi ba tshwanetse go bona ka ikonomi e e tserweng mo ikonoming e e tserweng.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha a re go tlhagelela mmasepala gore go na le bokgoni jwa diinvestor.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a le ntlha ya mokgatlho o o fetileng jaaka go nna mmuji wa gagwe morago go tswa mo go rona jaaka go tshwana le re go tshwana ka lefatshe la ga mmahoro Winnie.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Batho ba tlaa dira jalo go bona lekoko le le nne, mme go akaretsa, go na le diporojeke tse di tlaa dira.

items.hyp: Motsamaisi wa Ditshwaetso tsa Bosenyi mo kgatlhong ya Frere kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead, o ne a tlhagisitse gore go tsenngwa mo mafelong a go tshwara moletlo wa semolao ka nako ya kwa ntlong ya Easter, e tlaa tshwara go tswa mo ditlhophong di le mmalwa mo diwokeng tse di tlang.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.
